name: trinoris-securegit-workspace
description: Workspace root for @trinoris/securegit and @trinoris/securelib. Not published — see packages/securegit and packages/securelib for the real packages.

scripts.build: npm run build:securelib && npm run build --workspace=packages/securegit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:securelib && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:securelib && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:securelib && npm run test:integration --workspace=packages/securegit
scripts.chaos:sandbox: docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml up --build -d && docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml wait verifier; docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml logs verifier; docker compose -f chaos/docker-compose.yml down -v

author: TRINORIS
